note: Meade County KS parcels are only available through Schneider Beacon (subscription for full access, no public ArcGIS REST service) or commercial/per-request downloads (Equator, Dynamo, ORKA request process). The Ford County ArcGIS host (services7.arcgis.com/QfD34vvHtHcH5kGh) has a 'Parcels_' layer, but its features are in Ford/Gray County (around -99.99,37.75), not Meade; no Meade parcel polygon service exists there. Meade-named services on that host are address points, boundary and roads only. gis.rcgov.org is Rapid City, SD, not Kansas.
